item.tib: o rgyan nub phyogs dur khrod mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'di/ mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba pa'i/ bdag gi pha mas thog drangs nas/ nam mkha'i khyab pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ sgrib gnyis byang nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ phyi ma 'ol mo lung ring du/ rgyun zhugs 'gro don byed par shog kha ba can ljongs bod kyi yul/ 'phrul ngag bden pa'i g.yung drung bon/ bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas nas/ nam mkha' ci bzhin bkra shis shog u ya gnyan no/ de ltar rten gsum yon tan 'di/ mkha' 'gro nyi ma 'od ldan mas dbra btsun mu la rad na la brgyud pa'o//
